_comment: Who may SIGN IN to the console. Copy to config/principals.json (gitignored) and edit. This console signs in the institution's own MERIDIAN operators only -- role must be 'supervisor' or 'teller'; PrincipalStore.get refuses anything else, so there is no member sign-in. Passwords are stored as pbkdf2_sha256 hashes; `python -m bankcua.cli portal hash <password>` prints a new one, and a plaintext "password" field is accepted for hand-editing during a demo. This file holds NO Meridian credential: a sign-in names an operator ALIAS via `acts_as`, and the alias's secret still comes from config/credentials.json at invocation time.
_demo_passwords: super1 / password and teller1 / password are the operator sign-ins the target itself uses (https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com/signon). The console lets an operator in on the dropdown choice alone, so the password is only checked when one is supplied. Change them before this is anywhere but a demo.
